fato_historico: 1914: World War I: The Siege of Przemyśl (present-day Poland) begins.
energia_do_dia: The cosmos invites you to fortify your boundaries today, much like ancient walls standing firm against external pressures. It is a good time to reflect on your resilience and inner defense. Perhaps you may find that patience during challenging cycles allows your true, radiant nature to bloom, bringing a sense of deep, protective peace to your soul.
frase_do_dia: Strength is found in quiet persistence and the courage to remain steady within.
